page.overview:
Who is Flynn?

Flynn is a human boy who appears at the end of Issue 29. He is very similar to Finn in appearance. He has a dog named Blake.

Flynn has shaggy black hair, a red shirt, and a yellow backpack. He also wears a white scarf. He also has some teeth missing, similar to Finn.

In addition, Flynn has a yellow hat with a similar shape to Finn's hat, but in his only appearance he takes it off and tramples it in anger.
